title: Sunday Worship Service
subtitle: Join us in person or online every Sunday.
location: 10623 West Valley Road, SW, Calgary, AB T3B 5T2, Canada
description:
Come and worship with the RPC family every Sunday. Expect heartfelt praise and worship, the undiluted Word of God, and a warm, welcoming community.

Children's Church runs alongside the main service, so the whole family can grow together. Need a ride? You can request one on our website before Saturday at 5pm.
